A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MineDraft research work. All 28 pages in each version, including equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–D, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original throughput, latency, verification-success, ablation, and profiling results in Section 6 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results in Section 6 and Appendix C.

M1.justification: Section 5 retains the same batch assignment, alternating drafting and verification, scheduler patch, and fallback procedures. The corrected token-set definition does not establish an algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same decoding workloads on Arena, ShareGPT, Spec-Bench, and Tough. No datasets, tasks, or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding figures retain the same standard SD, PEARL, EAGLE, and TETRIS comparisons. Section 6.1 refines the wording about subsequent PEARL comparisons without changing comparator participation.

E3.justification: Model configurations, GPU allocation, generation settings, evaluation metrics, normalization procedures, and experimental controls remain unchanged in Section 6 and Appendix C.

E4.justification: The draft-size, extra-token, sequence-count, batch-size, VSR, communication-overhead, profiling, and parallelization-coverage analyses are retained with unchanged evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard deviations over three trials by default, two trials for Figure 24, and single-run profiling values in Table 1. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: The empirical plots, tables, numerical summaries, and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout Section 6 and Appendix C. The revised theoretical guarantee is assessed under T1.

T1.justification: Under the same acceptance model and lemmas, Theorem 1 changes from a ratio of approximately 1.59 at αV ≈ 1.68 to 1.61 at αV ≈ 2.23. Appendix B corrects equality to a strict lower bound and replaces the threshold/minimum argument with numerical maximization of L. Section 3 also corrects the draft-token set to include only newly drafted positions.

C1.justification: The introduction revises its theoretical contribution from at least 37% end-to-end latency reduction to 37.9% inference-time reduction under assumptions about draft quality and acceptance rate. The framework, experimental, and plugin contributions remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 4 replaces the sufficiently-large-parameter interpretation with a guarantee maximized near αV ≈ 2.23. Appendix C.4 correspondingly qualifies the theoretical comparison. The practical limitations and mechanism explanations elsewhere remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Both PDFs disclose the same software versions, hardware, hyperparameters, generation settings, implementation details, and code-access link. Appendix reflow does not add reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Removing the asterisk from one introductory EAGLE mention does not change the referenced methods or novelty claims.

P1.justification: Localized edits refine grammar, notation explanations, timing terminology, theoretical discussion, and the PEARL comparison statement. The overall section and appendix organization remains intact.

P2.justification: Equation formatting and appendix pagination change, shifting existing text and some figure/table positions. All 25 figures and two tables are retained with unchanged visual content.

improvement.justification: Appendix B removes v2's incorrect equality and mistaken decreasing-function minimum argument, while Section 4 states the guarantee's parameter dependence more precisely. Corrected draft-token indexing also improves mathematical consistency. These are useful, localized gains in rigor; the method and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
